title: Conditional κ = 7.49982571369270e-4: fixed-prime eight-level transfer on #300's gen5b-full package (+4.1e-12)
body:
Conditional κ = `749982571369270160072237/10^27` = **7.49982571369270160072237e-4**, +4.10 × 10⁻¹² over [#300](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/300) (7.49982567267028e-4). A small arithmetic refinement at the same word and the same conditional interfaces, not a new coding mechanism; the bit side still binds (below #233's complex supplier).

One self-contained package, `research/five-stage-gen5b-full-fixed-prime/`, on #300's branch; no existing file is changed. #300's complete `five-stage-gen5b-full` package (150 files, commit `aea3dc9`, `upstream-files.json`) is vendored unchanged under `source/`.

**Full replay: PASS** (`verify.py --output`, 369 s): the vendored #300 verifier end to end (all twelve stages fresh, κ `187495641816757/250000000000000000`), then `prime_eight_port.py` on its fresh `certificate.json`/`finite.json`/`primes.json`/`banks.json`, compared key by key with the committed `certificate.json`.

## What it is

jacklightChen's [#293](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/293) port (on #291) of the fixed-prime / eight-finite-level method (Nespoli #235, Arun #243/#261/#265, sennemmi #253), re-pinned to #300's actual costs: q = 2¹²⁷ − 1 (Lucas–Lehmer residues checked), ρ = 3,456,000/q, the entire 32m² rank-one fallback, two exact interval moment engines, eight finite acyclic ordinary levels, η = 10⁻²⁴, β = 10⁻⁹, all 47 strict outer constraints and seven margins; adjacent coarse/final 10⁻²⁷ points rejected by both engines, the old fallback density rejected at the new rate, four foreign fee vectors and a cyclic eighth level rejected.

Complete paid transfer: 60 physical replicas; literal stock 1,229,680 = 5·W (W = 245,936); literal children 28,973,400; rank mass 147,297,600 (normalized 29,459,520, deficit 52,800, max child 50); 910 charts, 4,627,800 bank assignments, normalizer bound 815, selector calls 905,935,487,400 = 2·5·60·((1,229,680 − 1) + 15,426·120·815) < 2⁴⁰; q-power coefficient 90,408,185,853,299,401 < 2⁸⁰ < q, internal row coefficient 14,401; maximum determinant 118 bits.

## Verify

```bash
python3 -m pip install -r research/five-stage-gen5b-full-fixed-prime/source/requirements.txt
```
```bash
python3 -B research/five-stage-gen5b-full-fixed-prime/verify.py --output /tmp/gen5b-full-fixed-prime-verification
```

About 7 minutes; prints `PASS complete gen5b-full fixed-prime eight-level reproduction` with κ. `--check-package` checks hashes and syntax only.

## Scope and credits

Exactly #300's hypotheses and conditional interfaces; no Lean build (`methods/Prime.lean` is #293's sketch, retained unchanged). Method: Nespoli (#235), sennemmi (#253), jacklightChen (#293, the package form reused here); the supplier is #300 (rohanarun, composing chafreaky's #296/#295, DreamingOfClouds, utcorvusvolat-dotcom, Dugongue, eumemic, hcg890/Jacob Sussman, Evan McKinney; see `source/NOTICE.md`).
